annotations.text:
FantasyGuru — v1 Android, dark theme. 412 × 915dp, 24dp status inset top, 24dp gesture inset bottom, 20dp screen padding.

The rule everything else follows: the UI is monochrome slate, and the only saturated colour on screen is status. Red / amber / green appear ONLY where the app reports a lineup condition. The steel-blue accent (#7FA3CC) means tappable, never important. Nothing else gets colour — not branding, not the live scoreboard, not win/loss margins, not the error states. Where something has to stand out, it does it with size, weight or space.

Type: Archivo for the verdict and big numbers, IBM Plex Sans for sentences, IBM Plex Mono for league names, timestamps and labels — so machine facts read as machine facts and the hierarchy stays pointed at the verdict.

ROW 1 — ONBOARDING
One field, no password. 02 names the work as it happens rather than shimmering: real steps, real counts, a determinate bar.

ROW 2 — THE CORE LOOP
Home in both states, then the three screens it leads into.

THE SQUINT TEST
03 and 04 differ at one second and across a room: a green sentence and a column of green dots, or a red sentence, three red rails and red dots. Nothing else on either screen carries hue, so the difference cannot be missed or misread.

03 had to feel resolved, not empty — so the calm state carries a short receipt of what was actually checked, all zeros. That is the closed loop: proof of work, not a placeholder.

ROW 3 — SYSTEM SURFACES
08 shows lock screen and expanded shade in one frame. 10 stacks the three empty/error states.

CONTENT
Every league, score, player, alarm and timestamp is verbatim from the brief. Three additions, all flagged: three bench players on 05 (the brief specifies a bench but no bench content), the playing/to-play counts on 07, and 07 reads 4:12 PM because its job is Sunday afternoon while every other screen is 10:14 AM.

Morning point totals are labelled PROJ / PROJECTED — at 10:14 AM nothing has been scored yet.
